title: Dissecting Racial Bias in an Algorithm that Guides Health Decisions for 70 Million People
abstract: A single algorithm drives an important health care decision for over 70 million people in the US. When health systems anticipate that a patient will have especially complex and intensive future health care needs, she is enrolled in a 'care management' program, which provides considerable additional resources: greater attention from trained providers and help with coordination of her care.
